question: Which of the following statements is best related to the 'pacific ring of fire'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Known for volcano and earthquakes**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Known for volcano and earthquakes** is the best related statement to the '**Pacific Ring of Fire**'.
 
• The Pacific Ring of Fire is a major area in the basin of the Pacific Ocean where a large number of earthquakes and volcanic eruptions occur.
